visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth): A wasp larva inside a mud-daubed nest tube; Top-Right (Dining): The wasp hovering over a lepidosaur (lizard) to scavenge or hunt; Bottom-Left (Sleeping): Suspended from a twig by its mandibles, wings still; Bottom-Right (Activity): The wasp 'cleaning' its antennae with its front legs while perched on a purple stone.
visual_logic.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; ensure the 'waist' is visible and the wings have a slight prismatic shimmer.
